what: Access London Datastore Data and Resources
title: Access London Datastore Data and Resources
text: ldndatar2 provides functions access download data, metadata, resources London Datastore. package updated successor original ldndatar package, utilising current London Datastore API. allows users programmatically catalogue, query, retrieve update datasets resources published Greater London Authority partner organisations.

title: Access London Datastore Data and Resources
text: can install ldndatar2 directly GitHub. package available CRAN. using remotes:

title: Access London Datastore Data and Resources
code: library(ldndatar2)  # Browse available datasets datasets <- lds_metadata(type = "datasets")  # Browse available resources resources <- lds_metadata(type = "resources")  # Download metadata for a specific dataset metadata <- lds_download_metadata(slug = "your-dataset-slug")  # Download a resource to your working directory (folder) lds_download_resource(slug = "your-dataset-slug")

title: Access London Datastore Data and Resources
text: datasets London Datastore private require API key. See vignette("get_london_datastore_api_key") instructions obtaining one.
code: # Access a private dataset using an API key metadata <- lds_download_metadata(slug = "private-dataset-slug", api_key = "your-api-key")

what: Add a resource to a London Datastore dataset — lds_add_resource
title: Add a resource to a London Datastore dataset — lds_add_resource
text: Uploads file new resource existing dataset London Datastore. Requires API key write access.

title: Add a resource to a London Datastore dataset — lds_add_resource
code: lds_add_resource(   file_path,   slug,   api_key,   res_title = NULL,   description = NULL,   temporal_coverage_from = NULL,   temporal_coverage_to = NULL,   update_timestamp = TRUE )

title: Add a resource to a London Datastore dataset — lds_add_resource
text: file_path Path file upload. slug URL slug dataset – https://data.london.gov.uk/dataset/<slug>. api_key London Datastore API key (required write operations). res_title Resource title. NULL, file name used. Default: NULL. description Description resource. Default: NULL. temporal_coverage_from Optional start date (Date character). Default: NULL. temporal_coverage_to Optional end date (Date character). Default: NULL. update_timestamp Whether set dataset's "updated " timestamp current time upload. Default: TRUE.
